title: aDNA — the open standard & network for shared context
desc: aDNA (agentic DNA) is an open standard for organizing a project's files so AI agents — and the people working with them — always know where things live. This site is the standard, its docs, and the vault registry.
ogTitle: aDNA — the open standard & network for shared context
